_comment: Historic /tienda/?categoria=<value> query strings reported by GSC (DAFA: blocked by robots.txt; DWAD: alternate with proper canonical). No component currently generates these links. Values are the exact decoded display-name that appeared in the GSC export. Maps to the current category slug when a real equivalent exists; 'null' means no equivalent — leave as a documented, expected exclusion (do not redirect, do not touch robots.ts).
